narrative.overview:
This is a system that disappears into the task. The cashier sees totals, tax breakdowns, and change due. The manager sees today's revenue, top movers, and register differences. Neither notices the interface. The design exists to make numbers legible, actions immediate, and errors impossible to miss.

The aesthetic is Notion-meets-Fluent: warm neutrals, a single blue accent used sparingly for primary actions, flat surfaces separated by thin ruled lines rather than shadows, and a typographic hierarchy built on weight and tracking rather than color or decoration. The system is dense where density serves the operator (tables, dashboards, tax configuration) and spacious where focus matters (checkout, login).

What this system explicitly rejects: generic "AI SaaS" landing aesthetics with purple-to-blue gradients and glassmorphism on every surface; cards-inside-cards-inside-cards nesting; bouncy or elastic easing; gray text on colored backgrounds; consumer-mobile shopping-app energy; anything that reads "demo" or "concept."
keyCharacteristics: Single accent color (Operational Blue) reserved for primary actions only
Tracked uppercase labels (CharacterSpacing=40) as the metadata signal
Platform-native typography (Segoe UI Variable) at a tight fixed scale
Square global CornerRadius with intentional radius on interactive elements
Semantic color vocabulary always paired with icons and text

rules.name: The Numbers-First Rule
rules.body: Totals, taxes, change due, stock levels, and register differences always win the visual hierarchy contest. Numerals get the largest size, the heaviest weight, and the highest contrast on any surface. Decorative chrome never competes with them.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Operational Blue appears on primary actions and current selection only. Its rarity is the point. If more than 10% of a screen is blue, something is wrong.

rules.name: The Tracking Rule
rules.body: Every label that describes a data field uses CharacterSpacing=40. This is the system's single strongest visual signal for 'this is metadata, not content.' Never apply tracking to body text or values.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no ThemeShadow, no elevation tokens. If a new surface needs to feel distinct, use a 1px border or a background color step. Shadows are prohibited outside the checkout cart card exception.

dos: Do use Operational Blue (#1976D2) exclusively for primary actions and current selection.
Do apply CharacterSpacing=40 to every field label, table header, and KPI label.
Do use 1px Ruled Line (#E8EAF0) borders to separate surfaces.
Do give numerals the largest size and heaviest weight on any surface.
Do use semantic color triples (background + border + text) for all state communication.
Do keep transitions at 80ms or instant.
Do honor the OS reduced-motion setting.
Do maintain full keyboard operation for every cashier task.
donts: Don't use shadows or ThemeShadow on any surface except the checkout cart card Translation exception.
Don't use purple-to-blue gradients, glassmorphism, or oversized hero cards in operational UI.
Don't use bouncy, elastic, or playful easing.
Don't use gray text on colored backgrounds or neon accents.
Don't use Inter, custom web fonts, or display typefaces.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use decorative emoji as icons or inspirational empty-state copy.
Don't animate numbers that the user is actively reading.
Don't auto-dismiss confirmations of destructive actions.
Don't make anything look like a demo or concept.
